name: Assassination Chain
look: Two stacked stills in a church. Top: a smiling man in a suit sits in a pew as a dark-haired woman behind him holds a pistol to his head and a blonde woman behind her holds one to hers. Bottom: a wide shot of the three in the pews, a shadowy man in the right foreground.
use: A chain of threats where each person holds the one in front at gunpoint. Each figure gets a label, showing how one thing controls another, which is controlled by something else, like a chain of bosses, chores or deadlines.
slots: label on the smiling man in front
label on the dark-haired woman behind him
label on the blonde woman at the back
label on the man in the bottom panel's foreground
